# Documentation map

Every project in this workspace uses the same layout, so people and Claude sessions find things in the same place. Start with `docs/delivery/next.md`, then the task file it points to.

| Folder or file | Holds | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `delivery/next.md` | What to do now, in order | Generated |
| `delivery/tasks/` | One file per task: outcome, acceptance, steps, files it may change, checks | Generated |
| `delivery/delivery-plan.md` | The whole plan by phase, in dependency order | Generated |
| `delivery/process-log.md` | Decisions, surprises and lessons, one entry per session | Written |
| `delivery/risk-register.md` | Active and resolved risks | Written |
| `workflow/workflow.md` | Session start and end, the task loop, how to regenerate | Generated |
| `workflow/definition-of-done.md` | When a task and a phase count as done, and every check | Generated |
| `workflow/tools.md` | Stack and versions, commands, Claude Code skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers, services | Written |
| `product/` | Why the project exists and for whom: problem brief, vision, personas, PRD, data plan (`data/` for data specifications), metrics, glossary | Written |
| `architecture/` | How the system is built: system context, containers, API contract, data model, UI and dashboard specs | Written |
| `decisions/` | Architecture decision records, one per decision | Written |
| `evaluation/` | Measured results, the demo script and how results were produced | Written |
| `images/` | Screenshots and diagrams for the README and docs | Written |
| `guides/` | User or developer guides (for example an SDK guide), only when the project ships one | Written |
| `../CHANGELOG.md` | Every change that landed, newest first | Written |
| `../.github/pull_request_template.md` | The definition-of-done checklist on every pull request | Template |
| `../LICENSE` | MIT licence (professional projects) | Template |

Generated files come from the task plan `shared/tasks/<project>.json` in the workspace; never edit them by hand (see `.claude/rules/generated-docs.md`). Written files follow the templates in the workspace `templates/projects/`.

Each folder has a README guide from the workspace `templates/projects/skeleton/`, refreshed by `project-docs.ps1`. Code lives outside `docs/`: `api/` and `web/` (or `frontend/`) as ADR-001 decides, `scripts/` for helpers, tests beside the code they cover, and synthetic data in `data/`. Claude Code files follow the [official layout](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-directory): `CLAUDE.md` loads `AGENTS.md`, `HANDOFF.md` and `docs/delivery/next.md`; `.claude/settings.json`, hooks and rules are committed; `.claude/settings.local.json` and `CLAUDE.local.md` are personal and git-ignored.
